artifact.reason: Main FastAPI application where Cloudflare auth middleware must be added. Contains existing request logging middleware pattern to follow.
Logging utility used for structured audit logging of auth events.
Currently accepts user_id in request body (Telegram flow). Web flow will use request.state.user_id from middleware.
Streaming endpoint that will need access to user_id from request.state.
Add pyjwt>=2.8.0 dependency for JWT decoding.

python.package: JWT decoding for Cloudflare Access tokens (to be added)

constraints.constraint: Follow existing middleware pattern in main.py (async def middleware_fn(request, call_next))
No JWT signature verification needed - Cloudflare already verified the token
USER_MAPPING is hardcoded dict for now (single user: user@example.com to YOUR_USER_ID)
Middleware must NOT break existing Telegram flow - only applies when CF headers present
For Telegram requests without CF headers, middleware should pass through (not reject)
Middleware runs before route handlers - user_id attached to request.state
Use api.logging.get_logger for structured logging with extra fields

interface.name: CloudflareAuthMiddleware
interface.signature: async def cloudflare_auth_middleware(request: Request, call_next) -> Response

interface.name: Request State
interface.path: Used by routes to access authenticated user

interface.name: CF Headers
interface.signature: CF-Access-JWT-Assertion: JWT token, CF-Access-Authenticated-User-Email: email string

tests.standards: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Follow existing test patterns in backend/tests/unit/. Mock HTTP requests using unittest.mock or httpx.MockTransport. Create test JWTs with jwt.encode(). Test files go in backend/tests/unit/test_cloudflare_auth.py.

ideas.idea: Test valid JWT with known email maps to correct user_id, attached to request.state
Test unknown email returns 401 with clear error message

Test successful auth logs email, user_id, path
Test failed auth logs reason (unknown email, missing headers, decode error)
Test middleware is properly integrated and runs before route handlers
